originality.rationale: Published 2024 lower-bound existence theorems do not assert a q=2 cubic-surface section spectrum. The 2023 Vikulova theorem identifies the maximally symmetric 28-orbit by automorphisms, not the transversality property or the further 1680-orbit. Direct primary literature comparisons and searches did not reveal a source proving the joint classification; older Dickson-type catalogues remain a meaningful qualification.
residual_risks: An unindexed table in Dickson or Karaoğlu may implicitly classify the same projective orbits; a full-text decisive comparison could modify publication priority.
An undiscovered computational treatment of the dual cubic-surface discriminant over F2 could contain the exact section spectrum.
